name: Baari
summary: Committee (BC) savings tracker with monthly shares, an animated jar draw, payouts and reminders
about: A tracker for a rotating savings committee, the BC or committee that friends, families and colleagues run in Pakistan. It keeps members and their shares, who has paid this month, the turn order with an animated draw from a jar of folded slips, the payout history and a list of ready WhatsApp reminders, all in PKR. Built for the organiser who collects every month.
how: This month shows the pot filling up, who has paid (green ticks) and a live countdown to the draw.
Open Collection and tap a member to mark their share paid (full or part); tap again to undo. Switch months to see the history and the payment record.

Open The draw and press Shake the jar: the jar shakes, one folded slip rises and unfolds with the winner's name, and confetti falls. In Fixed order mode, drag the list or use the arrows to set future turns.
Payouts lists every turn; mark the pot as paid out and print a payout slip.
Reminders lists members who still owe, each with a button that opens a ready WhatsApp text (wa.me link). Edit the text and copy all messages.
Add or edit members and shares (a two-share member gets two turns), and change the share, due day, draw day and place in Settings.
